mapper.update: INSERT INTO user_lifetime_traffic_checkpoint(user_id,session_key,uploaded,downloaded) VALUES(#{p.userId},#{p.key}::uuid,#{p.baselineUpload},#{p.baselineDownload}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT uploaded,downloaded FROM user_lifetime_traffic_checkpoint WHERE user_id=#{p.userId} AND session_key=#{p.key}::uuid FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE user_lifetime_traffic_checkpoint SET uploaded=GREATEST(uploaded,#{p.upload}),downloaded=GREATEST(downloaded,#{p.download}) WHERE user_id=#{p.userId} AND session_key=#{p.key}::uuid

WITH added AS (INSERT INTO user_career_events(user_id,kind,fingerprint,observed_at,reporter_id) VALUES(#{p.userId},#{p.kind},#{p.key}::uuid,#{p.moment},NULL) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING user_id,kind,observed_at) INSERT INTO user_career_daily(user_id,day,kind,amount) SELECT user_id,(observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date,kind,1 FROM added ON CONFLICT(user_id,kind,day) DO UPDATE SET amount=user_career_daily.amount+1

WITH added AS (INSERT INTO user_career_events(user_id,kind,fingerprint,observed_at,reporter_id) SELECT DISTINCT ua.owner,'observation',#{p.observationKey}::uuid,#{p.moment},#{p.userId} FROM userapps_heartbeat hb JOIN userapp ua ON ua.id=hb.userapp_id WHERE hb.ip=#{p.ip}::inet AND ua.owner<>#{p.userId} AND hb.first_seen_at<=#{p.moment} AND hb.last_seen_at>=#{p.started} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_account_deletion_request d WHERE d.user_id=ua.owner AND d.status='COMPLETED') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING user_id,kind,observed_at) INSERT INTO user_career_daily(user_id,day,kind,amount) SELECT user_id,(observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date,kind,COUNT(*) FROM added GROUP BY user_id,kind,observed_at ON CONFLICT(user_id,kind,day) DO UPDATE SET amount=user_career_daily.amount+EXCLUDED.amount

INSERT INTO user_career_torrent_time AS activity(user_id, torrent_id, last_seen, was_seeding) VALUES(#{p.userId}, #{p.torrentId}, #{p.moment}, #{p.seeding}) ON CONFLICT(user_id,torrent_id) DO UPDATE SET seeding = activity.seeding + CASE WHEN activity.was_seeding AND EXCLUDED.last_seen > activity.last_seen THEN tstzmultirange(tstzrange(activity.last_seen, LEAST(EXCLUDED.last_seen, activity.last_seen + interval '5 minutes'),'[)')) ELSE '{}'::tstzmultirange END, downloading = activity.downloading + CASE WHEN NOT activity.was_seeding AND EXCLUDED.last_seen > activity.last_seen THEN tstzmultirange(tstzrange(activity.last_seen, LEAST(EXCLUDED.last_seen, activity.last_seen + interval '5 minutes'),'[)')) ELSE '{}'::tstzmultirange END, was_seeding = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.last_seen > activity.last_seen THEN EXCLUDED.was_seeding ELSE activity.was_seeding END, last_seen = GREATEST(activity.last_seen,EXCLUDED.last_seen);

INSERT INTO public.user_lifetime_traffic AS totals (user_id, sent_self, received_self, sent_ack, received_ack, tracked_since, history_partial, updated_at) SELECT contribution.user_id, SUM(contribution.sent_self), SUM(contribution.received_self), SUM(contribution.sent_ack), SUM(contribution.received_ack), GREATEST(u.register_at, now()), TRUE, now() FROM ( SELECT #{p.userId} AS user_id, #{p.uploadDelta}::numeric AS sent_self, #{p.downloadDelta}::numeric AS received_self, 0::numeric AS sent_ack, 0::numeric AS received_ack UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT ua.owner, 0::numeric, 0::numeric, #{p.downloadDelta}::numeric, #{p.uploadDelta}::numeric FROM public.userapps_heartbeat heartbeat JOIN public.userapp ua ON ua.id = heartbeat.userapp_id WHERE heartbeat.ip = #{p.ip}::inet AND heartbeat.first_seen_at <= #{p.moment} AND heartbeat.last_seen_at >= #{p.started} ) contribution JOIN public."user" u ON u.id = contribution.user_id WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_account_deletion_request d WHERE d.user_id = u.id AND d.status = 'COMPLETED') GROUP BY contribution.user_id, u.register_at ORDER BY contribution.user_id ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET sent_self = totals.sent_self + EXCLUDED.sent_self, received_self = totals.received_self + EXCLUDED.received_self, sent_ack = totals.sent_ack + EXCLUDED.sent_ack, received_ack = totals.received_ack + EXCLUDED.received_ack, tracked_since = totals.tracked_since, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at;

WITH added AS (INSERT INTO user_career_events(user_id,kind,fingerprint,observed_at,reporter_id) SELECT owner,#{p.kind},#{p.key}::uuid,#{p.moment},NULL FROM userapp WHERE id=#{p.appId} ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING user_id,kind,observed_at) INSERT INTO user_career_daily(user_id,day,kind,amount) SELECT user_id,(observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date,kind,1 FROM added ON CONFLICT(user_id,kind,day) DO UPDATE SET amount=user_career_daily.amount+1
